mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing promethazine metabolism via CYP2D6 while additive CNS depression and antiplatelet effects may occur.
action: Monitor for increased sedation and CNS depression; counsel patient to avoid concurrent use if possible, or reduce promethazine dose; assess bleeding risk if turmeric used chronically.
